_doc: Effort per engine (brief 2.3, 2.7). Owner: effort. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_stations, which also holds every number here to the brief's safety envelope (BRIEF 4.6.1, 4.6.2, 4.6.6, 4.6.8): G2 tuning cannot move one past it. Plans: per engine and segment type, the PlanPhase mode and its numbers; every engine needs an entry for every segment type of its table; the mission file gives each segment's kind and length. WARMUP-kind segments (the hangar, the roll-out, free roam's depot drive-out, the drill's skirmish) use the warm-up numbers of the boiler (3% x min(pressure, 1)), the hoist (1%) and terrain (0..+2%). Bank (pattern 1): every target is clamp(base_pct + span_pct x (1 - bank/100), lo, hi) of the rider's phase effective_range(), clamped before the max_step_pts limit and the sub-steps; it runs in every dynamo phase with a range_pct (stages, boss and the drill's skirmish, so 55..65 there), never in the hangar, the roll-out, the depot or checkpoints. The SIM power band the director publishes is tanks.json in_band.sim_ftp_pct (one source); the first 300 s is TankConst.FIRST_S. v2 contracts: the arc generator (the Bastion's fourth engine, slot 3's start) has plan entries from brief 2.3's table (depot ERG 50 -> 65, stages ERG 65 in [65, 80]; the drill 50, then 55 in [55, 65]); its arc-load pattern is stations.json arc (brief 2.3 pattern 2). v2 removed the Ram haptic (brief 2.7). Crew 4 rotates slot s in stage k to the engine (s + k) mod 4 of diesel, dynamo, steam, arc. v3 contracts (2026-10-28): one tank (the landship, five seats) for every crew size; start_engines.landship lists the seat of each slot (a crew of n uses the first n: Drive, Gun, Loader, Lights; the solo rider on Drive until the rules builder adds automatic seating); rotation is gone (brief v3: seat choice replaces it), so every slot keeps its start seat for the whole mission; the Bulwark's plans and its hoist pattern are retired with its gearbox; feed, the new Secondaries seat, rides SIM flat in every segment (brief v3 effort table). v3 rules (2026-10-28): the Drive seat digs the berm at a gun line in SIM flat (v2's ERG 90% gun-line block is gone; brief v3 effort table), the solo rider's start seat is Drive and automatic seating moves it (TankAutopilot); a seat switch replans the rest of the rider's plan for the new seat (TankSeatPlan: the rest of the current segment as its own phase, then every later segment), from these same tables. v1.1.0 (2026-11-08): the 300 s depot is the Hangar (180 s) and the Roll-out (120 s), both WARMUP: the ERG seats ride 50 -> 59 and 59 -> 65 (the same one ramp of 0.05 points a second as the depot's 300 s, never above 65%), the Drive seat SIM flat in the hangar (the hull sits on its stand) and the terrain's 0..+2% on the roll-out, every other SIM seat flat; the first 300 s are unchanged.

roam_plans._doc: Free roam (brief 2.10): the drive-out is the depot's targets and models (WARMUP, no enemies); the roam is one open-ended WORK phase per rider on the engine of its slot for the whole session (no rotation): the diesel SIM game on the valley's grade, the dynamo ERG 55% with the bank pattern in range_pct [55, 85], the steam engine SIM flat with the boiler, the arc generator ERG 65% with the arc pattern in [65, 80], (v3) the feed SIM flat. Every roam phase is longer than 300 s, so BRIEF 4.6.1's 105% cap applies; every bound here is at most 85%.

arc._doc: Pattern 2 (the arc generator, brief 2.3; v3 the Lights seat): every every_s an update toward base_pct + span_pct x duty (duty: the searchlight load, the share of the last 10 s an enemy stood in the main gun's range, TankArcState), clamped to the phase's effective range_pct, moving at most max_step_pts from the last sent target, in substeps sub-steps substep_s apart (<= 3.3% FTP/s, BRIEF 4.6.2); only in arc ERG phases with a range_pct, never in the depot or checkpoints.

repair._doc: Pattern 10 (v4, the Repairs seat): the arc's schedule, every every_s an update toward base_pct + span_pct x duty (TankRepairState.duty), clamped to the phase's range_pct, inside the same 3.3% FTP/s envelope as bank and arc.

boiler._doc: Pattern 3: grade_pct x min(pressure, 1) in WORK SIM phases, warmup_grade_pct x min(pressure, 1) in WARMUP-kind ones; 0 while the loader idles (v3: the ready rack is full).
